title: Unit Event — Live with Memories — Episode6 Happy Memories

meta.Event Outline: The wind is in Leo/need's sails as the band continues performing and starts to build its own fanbase. But then, they encounter a brother and sister, who are Leo/need fans, having an argument.

rows.Line: Ichika's Room

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
No, this doesn't feel right.
It needs to be more...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (It has to remind them of all their happy memories even when they're apart from one another.)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (I don't actually know much about them...)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (But I have to think these memories exist.)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (I mean, I'm here doing this because I had so much fun with the others...)

rows.Speaker: Little Ichika
rows.Line: What's the matter, Saki?

rows.Speaker: Little Saki
rows.Line: Hehehe... Just making a wish that we could stay like this forever!

rows.Speaker: Little Saki
rows.Line: Playing together, talking about stuff, watching shooting stars on our way home...

rows.Speaker: Little Saki
rows.Line: I wish we could keep doing all that together forever!

rows.Speaker: Little Ichika
rows.Line: I wish we could, too.

rows.Speaker: Little Honami
rows.Line: Me three!

rows.Speaker: Little Shiho
rows.Line: Same.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (The girls and I are back together again because of our own wonderful memories.)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (I know those two might not have a choice but to go their separate ways at this point. However...)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (As long as they have these memories and look forward to the future, I'm sure they'll someday be able to look back and smile...)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (This is what I want this song to be about...)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Okay, here... “To you”...? No, “For you”... That sounds much better...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
(That's it for the first verse...
I'll take a quick break before starting the second.)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (Oh, maybe I should look over the first verse again to make sure it doesn't sound weird.)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: “Add up all the joy you've felt since you met”...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: That reminds me...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (Meeting everyone was the best thing that's ever happened to me.)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (But this other discovery made me feel almost just as happy.)

rows.Speaker: Little Ichika's Voice
rows.Line: What do I do...?

rows.Speaker: Little Ichika's Voice
rows.Line: (I tapped something and made Dad's tablet play this video...)

rows.Speaker: Little Ichika's Voice
rows.Line: (Who's this green-haired girl?)

rows.Speaker: Little Ichika's Voice
rows.Line:
(Oh, she started singing...
I've never heard this song before...)

rows.Speaker: Little Ichika's Voice
rows.Line: ...! Wow! She's so amazing...!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (I got so worked up that I couldn't fall asleep that night and almost ran late the next day...)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (I hurried over to school to ask Saki and the others about playing this song together...)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Hehe. That really takes me back...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
(I discovered Miku songs...
And I ended up meeting her in SEKAI...)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (Without her, we probably wouldn't have been able to come back together like this...)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (I can't even begin to describe how thankful I am for that...)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
(I know...
I should work these feelings into my lyrics.)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
(The joy of meeting someone...
And this desire to keep singing with them.)
Morning

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Done...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (Thank you so much for the advice you gave me, Luka...)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
(Uh oh...
I'm glad I'm done, but I feel so sleepy now...)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (We're supposed to practice in SEKAI in the morning too... I should probably get in a quick nap...)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
(No, I should just head over...
We need to write the music for this and start practicing it.)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
(Also...
I really want to hear what everyone thinks.)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (I hope this song's able to ease some of the pain those two are feeling right now...)
bgm_area00001
School SEKAI

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (I'm early, and it looks like no one else is here yet... Miku and the others should be... Huh?)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Miku's sleeping while sitting...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (Oh, the chalkboard behind her is covered in ideas for our song...)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (Did she come up with these with everyone else after I left...?)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Thank you so much, Miku...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Morning!!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Huh?!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Eep!
Wh-What's going on...?!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Oh, Ichi! Miku!
Morning! You're both here so early!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Shiho! Hona!
Ichi's already here!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
She is?
You know what time it is, right?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Wait, Ichika, you didn't stay up all night, did you? Are you sure you're up to this?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Yes. I actually feel pretty good right now.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Hey, I thought I heard people!
You guys are already here!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: How can anyone have so much energy in the morning?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: I think that's actually a good thing...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Oh, KAITO, the hair on the back of your head needs some fixing.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Huh...?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Also, how are your lyrics coming along...?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Oh, they're done...!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Which is why I want to hear what you all think.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
(Everyone's gone so quiet...
Should I say something...?)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (Or did I not do very good...)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: *Sob*

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Huh?! Honami, what's wrong...?!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Huh...?! I'm sorry...
It's just... This reminded me of everything before we got our band back together...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: This reminded me of junior high too...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Yeah...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I was reminded of how I couldn't see any of you back then and the moment we got back together...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Thanks for writing such amazing lyrics, Ichi...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
*Gasp*
Thank goodness...!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: What do you and the others think, Miku?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: They're wonderful lyrics, Ichika...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Miku...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Oh no! Miku-P, are you okay?!
Len, get her a handkerchief!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
R-Rin, you don't have one?!
Oh, I think I left mine in the other classroom...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
Hehe. Here, Miku.
You can use this.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Th-Thank you...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
They really are wonderful lyrics, Ichika...
This song brings up some sad emotions, but gently wraps you in love and warmth...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Thank you very much, Luka...!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Alright!
Let's get down to writing music for it!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: The melody we came up with yesterday should go great with this... How does this sound?
se_event_memories_2022_001

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
That's astounding!
Oh, but... It might be good to slow it down a bit.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: I agree. A simpler sound and mellower pace would go better with these lyrics.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Okay, how about something like this?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: There...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: This... This is such a good song!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
It absolutely is...!
Not only does the music go perfectly with Ichika's lyrics, but the intro also really tugs at your heartstrings...!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Oh no... What if I start crying in the middle of playing it...?!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Do your best to hold back those tears.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Hehe.
I'm just glad we were able to come up with something that sounds right...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Oh...
Haha... Sounds like I worked up an appetite...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: We did sort of skip lunch to keep working on this.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Hehe. Nice work, girls!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: I can't believe you were able to come up with something this good in so little time. Your focus was incredible.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: I agree. It's clear how seriously you all took this.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Thank you all very much.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: The truth is, I kept thinking about all of you while writing these lyrics...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Wait, us?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Yes. Meeting Saki and the others was definitely an incredibly happy moment for me...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: But meeting all of you means just as much to me.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: You guys opened my eyes by teaching me that music comes in all shapes and sizes.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Now, we're back together as a band and trying to go pro.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: None of that would've been possible without any of you.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
So, Miku... Everyone...
Thank you very much.
I'm so grateful that we met.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I'll probably never get a chance like this again... Not even if I was reborn and given another opportunity...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Ichika...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: You say these really profound things from time to time...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
I know, right?!
It's like she becomes a total sage sometimes!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: What?!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: I agree...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Hehe.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: I hope this song has a positive effect on Hanano and her brother...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Me too!
